failure_analysis.root_cause: Very small acoustic footprint (< 15 pixels) at far range swath edge.
failure_analysis.remedy: Increase input resolution to 1024x1024 tiling with 25% overlap.

failure_analysis.root_cause: Cylindrical shape confusion with circular crab pot cage structure.
failure_analysis.remedy: Physics validator P95 metallic density weighting separates wire mesh from solid casing.

failure_analysis.root_cause: Buried crab pot frame with minimal acoustic shadow relief (< 0.2m).
failure_analysis.remedy: Incorporate multi-ping along-track stacking to boost low backscatter.

failure_analysis.root_cause: Heavy speckle noise in shallow water port channel.
failure_analysis.remedy: Adaptive Lee filter suppresses speckle while preserving wire frame speculars.

failure_analysis.root_cause: Highly fragmented historic wooden hull blending into rocky seabed.
failure_analysis.remedy: Second-stage texture entropy analysis detects anomalous angular contours.

failure_analysis.root_cause: Linear mast / keel structure detected without surrounding hull envelope.
failure_analysis.remedy: Morphological aspect ratio check in physics validator.

failure_analysis.root_cause: Partially buried subsea pipeline segment with intermittent shadow.
failure_analysis.remedy: Hough transform linear continuity tracking across adjacent tiles.

failure_analysis.root_cause: Entangled net draped over pipeline causing irregular linear backscatter.
failure_analysis.remedy: Dual-class hazard assignment for co-located pipeline and ghost net.

failure_analysis.root_cause: Synthetic monofilament net with low acoustic impedance difference to water.
failure_analysis.remedy: High-frequency TVG compensation to emphasize diffuse webbing scatter.

failure_analysis.root_cause: Large clumped ball of derelict net producing high specular highlight.
failure_analysis.remedy: P95 density check distinguishes soft polymer (P95 < 130) from steel hull (P95 > 200).

failure_analysis.root_cause: Isolated boulder with sharp acoustic shadow.
failure_analysis.remedy: SHARP height vs shadow ratio rejects natural round boulders (P95 < 160).

failure_analysis.root_cause: Periodic linear sandwaves mimicking parallel pipelines.
failure_analysis.remedy: Spatial frequency filter in preprocessor detects sand ripple periodicity.

failure_analysis.root_cause: Extreme scarcity of labeled aircraft sonar in training set (0 public samples).
failure_analysis.remedy: Recommend acquiring academic/NOAA aviation sonar surveys & synthetic CAD simulation.

failure_analysis.root_cause: Target located directly inside nadir blind zone.
failure_analysis.remedy: Flag nadir region with 'NADIR_BLIND_ZONE' quality warning.

failure_analysis.root_cause: Broken frame missing buoy line.
failure_analysis.remedy: Categorized under generic Hazardous Debris with high SURE rating.

failure_analysis.root_cause: Vehicle pitch distortion causing ping compression across along-track axis.
failure_analysis.remedy: Nav IMU pitch correction in SonarPreprocessor.

failure_analysis.root_cause: Suspended pipeline span cast shadow overlapping far range edge.
failure_analysis.remedy: Tile waterfall expansion across swath boundaries.

failure_analysis.root_cause: Low grazing angle causing shadow foreshortening.
failure_analysis.remedy: Altitude-normalized SHARP shadow mensuration formula.

failure_analysis.root_cause: Moored mine hovering above seabed rather than bottom-resting.
failure_analysis.remedy: Separate highlight-from-seabed shadow gap detection.

failure_analysis.root_cause: Biofouled net with heavy marine growth.
failure_analysis.remedy: Add biofouled synthetic net models to training augmentation pool.

data_acquisition_recommendations: Incorporate NOAA Bathymetric & SSS Public Archive for rare aircraft wreckage.
Acquire synthetic acoustic ray-tracing simulations for varied seabed grazing angles.
Conduct seasonal survey passes to build biofouled ghost net acoustic signatures.
